fusions.name: Strike From Stillness
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Lash
fusions.desc: A lash of the tail that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Muscle
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Daylight Stalker
fusions.desc: By day, you deal 10% more damage.
